channel for IDETrace @ NeurIPS D&B. deadline May 6. what we have: ~61k thirty-second windows from 4 course offerings, IDE telemetry + labels from 3 deployments. what we need: datasheet, splits, baselines, hosting
Reactions: +1 (2)

baselines plan: majority, logistic regression on hand features, GBDT (lightgbm), a small transformer over event sequences. macro-F1 over 5 states. splits 70/15/15, random by window for now

baseline results v1: GBDT 0.81 macro-F1, transformer 0.79, LR 0.66, majority 0.17. gbdt wins on stalled-after-error, which is funny

reviews are in: 6, 5, 4. R3 asks how splits were made and whether windows from one student can be in both train and test

ok so R3 is right. i checked: 96% of students have windows in both train and test. we split by window, not by student. this is leakage
